decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, one light-blue dot lit, no red X. The car is still on grass, paralleling the lane on its right; the tall pine trunk that was beside it is now to its left, the EXHAUST barrel row and blue puddles fill the left of frame, white/grey posts mark the lane edge, and a clear corridor of grass/pines lies ahead up-frame.
decision.hypothesis: Nothing is at the nose and the car is accelerating on grass. With more speed steering bites better, so building speed with plain W first gives a better chance of a successful short left steer onto the lane than turning now at 7 mph.
decision.memory: The EXHAUST-bend outside verge kills speed; plain W recovers reliably. Steer left only once speed is clearly above 10 mph, and keep the hold very short.
